parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance. To obtain the ID, call [DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of some returned parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: StrategyMode
parameters.description:
The access strategy mode. Valid values:

- GEO: Geolocation-based

- LATENCY: Latency-based
